source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the if-elif-else statement (PDF 42-43).

blocks.text: if-elif-else se hum kai conditions (shartein) baari baari check karte hain, aur har condition ke liye alag block hota hai. elif ka matlab hai "else if" (warna agar).

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
Yeh if-elif-else ki shakal (syntax) hai, poora program nahi.
"if condition1:": pehli shart; True ho to is ka indented block chalta hai aur baqi sab chhor diya jata hai.
"elif condition2:": elif yani "else if" (warna agar). Sirf tab check hoti hai jab pehli shart False ho. Zaroorat ho to kai elif lag sakte hain.
"else:": koi bhi shart True na ho to yeh block chalta hai; is ke saath shart nahi likhi jati.
Har "# code to run ..." ki jagah aap ka apna indented code aata hai. Poore dhaanche mein se sirf ek block chalta hai. Block mein sirf comment ho to IndentationError aata hai.

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"weather = "cloudy"": weather variable mein "cloudy". Isi line ka comment batata hai ke output is variable ki value par munhasir (depend) hai.
"if weather == "sunny":": "cloudy" barabar "sunny" nahi, False; yeh block chhor diya.
"elif weather == "rainy":": "cloudy" barabar "rainy" bhi nahi, False.
"else :": koi shart True nahi hui, is liye else wala block chalta hai.
Output: Enjoy your day!
Khud try karein: weather = "rainy" kar ke Run karein: ab "Take an umbrella" aayega. "Sunny" (bara S) likhein to Python ise "sunny" nahi maanti aur phir "Enjoy your day!" aayega.

blocks.alt: Flowchart: weather = "cloudy" se pehla sawal weather == "sunny"?; True ho to print("Wear sunglasses"). False ho to doosra sawal weather == "rainy"?; True ho to print("Take an umbrella"). Dono False hon to else: print("Enjoy your day!"). Teeno raaste aakhir mein Khatam par milte hain.
blocks.caption: if-elif-else ka flow: conditions baari baari check hoti hain (weather misal ka asal khaaka; kitab mein figure nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Oopar se neeche chalein: pehle 'sunny' wali condition check hoti hai. weather = "cloudy" hai, is liye yeh False hai aur hum neeche doosri condition 'rainy' par jate hain; yeh bhi False hai, is liye else wala block chalta hai aur "Enjoy your day!" print hota hai. Jo pehli condition True ho, sirf usi ka block chalta hai aur baqi chhor diye jate hain.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: if-elif-else statement likhein jo check kare ke number positive (zero se bara), negative (zero se chhota) ya zero hai.

blocks.prompt: Aisa program likhein jo number le kar bataye ke woh positive, negative ya zero hai (long question 5; class activity).
blocks.explanation: num = float(input("Enter a number: ")); if num > 0: print("Positive") elif num < 0: print("Negative") else: print("Zero"). Sirf ek branch (raasta) chalti hai: jis ki condition sab se pehle True ho.

items: if-elif-else: conditions upar se neeche; pehli True condition ka block chalta hai, warna else.
